notes.roles_not_paths: Entries declare artifact ROLES. Concrete paths are supplied per review at run time, because every review chooses its own approved directories. A role is how a consumer asks for an artifact by meaning rather than by filename.
notes.terminal_status: LOCKED when the phase produces its own content-hashed lock artifact; COMPLETED otherwise. The wrapper does not replace a phase's internal lock semantics, it references them.
notes.consumer_adopted: All fifteen skills are adopted, so every route's consumer is registered. The flag stays in the schema so a future unadopted route cannot be declared silently.
notes.no_downstream_creation: A producer publishes handoffs. It never creates a consumer's run directory or output directory, however distant the consumer.
notes.deferred_branches: Phase 14 meta-analysis and Phases 19-20 are deferred. They have no phase id, no registry entry, and no consumer route. A locked Phase 13 synthesis id classified META_ANALYSIS_PLANNED therefore receives no handoff and no directory: nothing here implies that branch exists.
notes.corrections_are_new_runs: A Phase 18 finding never mutates a locked run. The responsible workflow starts a NEW run whose parent_run_ids name the superseded run, and the prior locked run and its package stay byte-for-byte unchanged.
